name: Globe Life Inc.
one_liner: Steady niche life/supplemental-health insurer with exclusive-agent distribution, moat 5/10 — B by numbers on a TTM base (15.2% weighted, IV@15% $171 vs $169) but that B is within noise of the hurdle, the bear case is C, and the OCF base carries the insurer float/reserve component, so softened to C at low confidence; it clears 15% at ~$171 on engine numbers and with a margin of safety only near the bear IV of ~$117.
tier_override_reason: SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH insurer artifact (Andrew's standing rule, 2026-10-15; same treatment as PFG/HIG/ACGL/WRB/AIZ): the OCF-based OE base capitalizes float/reserve growth in the annual history (FY2023 OCF $1,482,425,000 vs net income $970,755,000; FY2024 $1,402,440,000 vs $1,070,762,000; FY2025 $1,396,391,000 vs $1,161,238,000), and the B is marginal — weighted IRR 15.18% is 0.18pp over the hurdle, the preliminary median-base run printed Tier C at 14.98%, and the bear case is Tier C (11.24%) with TIER_BAND directing sizing to the bear end. Softened one notch to C, confidence low. Noted honestly: the TTM base used ($14.80/share) sits below TTM net income per share and below management's raised 2026 operating-EPS guidance ($15.55–$15.95), so the softening rests on the sector fit, the annual-history float component and the marginality of the B, not on the TTM base exceeding net income.
